summary: The sole supplied 29/464 occurrence is already the inherited II Preterit-wa quotation, so no example is added.

Keep the established Preterit-wa label and detransitive=false for Mfaḥamwo. Its missing overt l-series ending is noteworthy, but this one form does not justify silently moving it to another box or reconstructing an inflection.

The experiencer's anger accompanies an inability or unwillingness to come forward; the Turoyo does not establish a separate lexical sense ‘unable to answer’ merely because that phrase occurs in the Arabic etymology.
The separate inherited Detransitive Infectum-wa mifaḥam-wa is not the supplied Mfaḥamwo form. Preserve both forms and their distinct existing labels pending editorial morphological analysis.
How should II mfaḥam-wo without an overt l-series ending be analysed relative to mifaḥam-wa? Confirm the inherited Preterit-wa versus Detransitive Infectum-wa distinction from the grammar source.
